decision: Retain the dense-prefix score owner only while the runtime's dense-initial metadata invariant is valid. Explicit eviction falls back to the registered metadata-aware fixed256 route. The score stage improves 12.8-14.6%, complete active leaves improve 1.95-5.28%, short decode is exact/noise-positive, and mandatory 128K improves 1.263%.
